adminTokens.createHint: The full token is shown only once, right after it is created.
adminTokens.name: Name

scopeHint.read: GET / HEAD and the live event stream
scopeHint.write: Every admin operation (except tokens, roles and admin passwords)

adminTokens.expiryInvalid: Pick a time in the future
adminTokens.ipHint: IP addresses or CIDR prefixes, one per line; empty = any address.
